nav.inventoryHubDescription: Choose a section to manage products, stock, and catalog data.
nav.adminHubDescription: Open dashboard, documentation, or reports from here.

notes.mentionHint: Type @ to link an order, purchase order, payment, or person.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.emptyLowStock: No low stock items. All products are well stocked.

control.title: Control
control.intro: Turn features on or off for this browser. Each item describes what it affects in the app.
control.securityNote: These toggles only hide or show UI. They do not block API access. Use database policies for real enforcement.

disabled.newOrder: Creating new orders is turned off in Control settings.
disabled.editDraft: Editing draft orders is turned off in Control settings.
disabled.ordersList: The order list is turned off in Control settings.
disabled.noOrderShortcuts: All order hub shortcuts are turned off in Control settings.
disabled.inventoryHubAllOff: All inventory hub shortcuts are turned off in Control settings.
disabled.adminHubAllOff: All Admin shortcuts are turned off in Control settings. Enable Dashboard, Documentation, or Reports under Navigation.
disabled.purchaseOrdersList: The purchase order list is turned off in Control settings.
disabled.noPurchaseOrderShortcuts: All purchase order hub shortcuts are turned off in Control settings.
disabled.newPurchaseOrder: Creating new purchase orders is turned off in Control settings.
disabled.noInventoryTransferShortcuts: All stock transfer shortcuts are turned off in Control settings.
disabled.newInventoryTransfer: Creating new stock transfers is turned off in Control settings.
disabled.inventoryTransfersList: The stock transfer list is turned off in Control settings.
disabled.warehouses: Warehouses are turned off in Control settings.
disabled.dashboardAllOff: Both dashboard tabs are turned off in Control. Turn on “Overview” or “Reports” to see content here.
disabled.dashboardOverviewEmpty: All overview sections are turned off in Control. Enable stats, financial snapshot, movements, or low stock to see widgets here.

dashboard.title: Dashboard menu
dashboard.desc: Shows the Dashboard item under the Admin group in the sidebar (home / overview).

control.title: Control menu
control.desc: Shows the Control link to open this feature settings page.

inventory.title: Inventory menu
inventory.desc: Shows the Inventory item in the sidebar (hub and sub-routes).

orders.title: Orders menu
orders.desc: Shows the Orders item in the sidebar.

people.title: People menu
people.desc: Shows the People item in the sidebar.

payments.title: Payments menu
payments.desc: Shows the Payments item in the sidebar (hub, history, and new payment).

register.title: Register menu
register.desc: Shows the Register item for cash-drawer balances by tender and manual add/withdraw.

admin.title: Admin menu
admin.desc: Shows the Admin link in the sidebar; opens the Admin hub with shortcuts to Dashboard, Documentation, and Reports.

documentation.title: Documentation page
documentation.desc: Shows the Documentation link under Admin and enables the /admin/documentation user guide route.

reports.title: Reports shortcut (sidebar)
reports.desc: Shows the Reports link under Admin (opens the dashboard Reports tab).

lowStockBell.title: Low stock alerts (bell)
lowStockBell.desc: Shows the bell icon and badge linking to low-stock products.

overviewTab.title: Overview tab
overviewTab.desc: Shows the main dashboard tab (stats and activity widgets).

reportsTab.title: Reports tab
reportsTab.desc: Shows the Reports tab on the home page and allows opening sales/inventory reports there.

statsCards.title: Top stat cards
statsCards.desc: Product count, inventory value, low-stock count, movements today, and purchases today.

financialSnapshot.title: Receivables & payables
financialSnapshot.desc: The two cards for total receivables and total payables.

recentMovements.title: Recent stock movements
recentMovements.desc: The table of latest stock in/out/adjustments on the overview.

lowStockPanel.title: Low stock list
lowStockPanel.desc: The low-stock products panel on the overview.

deposit.title: Add to register
deposit.desc: Allows recording money put into the register (by tender type).

withdraw.title: Withdraw from register
withdraw.desc: Allows recording money taken out of the register (by tender type).

viewActivity.title: Register activity
viewActivity.desc: Shows the recent activity table and the “View activity” shortcut on the Register page.

list.title: Transaction log
list.desc: Opens the full balance ledger: orders, purchase orders, payments, wallet, and adjustments.

editLedgerNote.title: Edit payment notes
editLedgerNote.desc: Allow changing the note on recorded payment-in / payment-out operations from the payment detail page.

reverseLedgerOperation.title: Reverse recorded payments
reverseLedgerOperation.desc: Allow undoing a payment-in / payment-out, or a register deposit/withdraw, from the payment detail page (ledger, balance, and linked order/PO rows when applicable).

fullLedgerView.title: Full ledger mode (transaction log)
fullLedgerView.desc: Shows the “Show full ledger” option on the payments list to expand reversed rows and see raw balance impact.

products.title: Products card
products.desc: Link from the inventory hub to the products list.

po.title: Purchase orders card
po.desc: Link from the inventory hub to purchase orders.

movements.title: Stock movements card
movements.desc: Link from the inventory hub to stock movements.

categories.title: Categories card
categories.desc: Link from the inventory hub to categories.

brands.title: Brands card
brands.desc: Link from the inventory hub to brands.

warehouses.title: Warehouses card
warehouses.desc: Link from the inventory hub to manage warehouses: display codes from location, optional register per site, default location, and safe register turn-off when the drawer is empty.

transfers.title: Stock transfers card
transfers.desc: Link from the inventory hub to move quantity between warehouses (no pricing).

viewProfile.title: View profile
viewProfile.desc: Shows the eye icon and allows opening the person profile dialog with balance and history.

editPerson.title: Edit person
editPerson.desc: Allows editing customer or supplier details from the list and from the profile dialog.

deletePerson.title: Delete person
deletePerson.desc: Shows the delete action when allowed by business rules.

recordPayment.title: Record payment
recordPayment.desc: Allows recording balance payments from Payments → New payment (choose person).

addPerson.title: Add person
addPerson.desc: Shows the button to create a new customer or supplier.

add.title: Add product
add.desc: Shows the Add product button on the products page.

edit.title: Edit product
edit.desc: Shows the edit (pencil) action for each product row.

delete.title: Delete product
delete.desc: Shows the delete action for each product row.

stockAdjust.title: Stock adjustment
stockAdjust.desc: Shows the stock adjust action to change quantity manually.

edit.title: Edit category
edit.desc: Shows inline edit for a category name.

delete.title: Delete category
delete.desc: Shows the delete action for a category.

edit.title: Edit brand
edit.desc: Shows inline edit for a brand name.

delete.title: Delete brand
delete.desc: Shows the delete action for a brand.

hubList.title: All purchase orders card
hubList.desc: Shows the shortcut to the purchase orders list on the purchase orders home page.

create.title: Create purchase order
create.desc: Shows the new purchase order shortcut and enables the full-page create flow (supplier picker, product browser, lines, payments).

costOverridePriceDialog.title: Cost override confirmation (new PO)
costOverridePriceDialog.desc: When a line cost differs from the catalog default, shows a dialog to choose “allow once” or update catalog prices (cost, retail, wholesale). When off, uses the inline checkbox to update default cost only.

confirmReceive.title: Confirm / receive draft PO
confirmReceive.desc: Shows the button on a draft purchase order to confirm receipt, enter supplier payments, and post stock.

cancel.title: Cancel purchase order
cancel.desc: Shows the cancel action on received purchase orders (detail page).

editNote.title: Edit purchase order note
editNote.desc: Allows editing the persisted note on a purchase order detail page (pen icon, save).

create.title: Create stock transfer
create.desc: Shows the new transfer shortcut and the form to move products between two warehouses (quantities only).

list.title: Stock transfer list
list.desc: Shows the list of past transfers and links to each transfer detail.

hubList.title: All orders card
hubList.desc: Shows the shortcut to the orders list on the orders home page.

hubNew.title: New order card
hubNew.desc: Shows the shortcut to create a new order and enables the new-order page.

editDraft.title: Edit draft orders
editDraft.desc: Allows opening the POS editor for draft orders from the order detail page.

saveDraft.title: Save draft
saveDraft.desc: Shows the Save draft button in the POS header.

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.desc: Shows the Checkout button and checkout flow (payments and confirm).

print.title: Print invoice
print.desc: Shows print invoice on the order detail page.

cancel.title: Cancel order
cancel.desc: Shows cancel order on the order detail page when status allows.

addPayment.title: Add payment (reserved)
addPayment.desc: Reserved for future use: partial payments on confirmed orders from the order screen. Checkout payments are controlled by Checkout and Record payment.

editNote.title: Edit order note
editNote.desc: Allows editing the order note field on the detail page.

export.title: Export CSV
export.desc: Shows export to CSV on dashboard reports (e.g. inventory value).

products.title: Products
products.searchPlaceholder: Search by name or product ID...
products.productIdHint: Leave empty to generate automatically (e.g. P-A1B2C3D4E5). Must be unique.
products.validationProductCodeMax: Product ID must be at most 64 characters
products.validationProductCodeFormat: Use only letters, numbers, dots, dashes, and underscores (no spaces)
products.validationDuplicateCode: This product ID is already in use
products.validationDuplicateName: A product with this name already exists
products.deleteConfirmMessage: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"? This action cannot be undone.
products.emptyProducts: No products found. Add your first product to get started.
products.validationNameMin: Name must be at least 2 characters
products.quantityManagedByPurchaseOrders: Quantity is managed through Purchase Orders
products.detailNoSalesInRange: No completed sales in this date range.
products.detailNoMovements: No stock movements recorded for this product.
products.averageUnitCostHint: Weighted average of purchase line costs for on-hand stock. Updates when you receive stock on a purchase order (or stock in using catalog cost).
products.grossProfitSoldHint: From completed orders only: line revenue minus units sold × current average unit cost (WAC). Uses today’s WAC as an estimate of cost of goods sold.
products.totalProfitFromSalesHint: All completed orders (retail + wholesale): total line revenue minus total units sold × current average unit cost (WAC). Same method as the table rows; WAC is an estimate of COGS.

categories.deleteConfirmMessage: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"?
categories.emptyCategories: No categories yet. Add your first category.

categories.validationNameExists: A category with this name already exists
categories.toastInUse: Category is in use and cannot be deleted

brands.title: Brands
brands.deleteConfirmMessage: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"?
brands.emptyBrands: No brands yet. Add your first brand.
brands.validationNameMin: Name must be at least 2 characters
brands.validationNameExists: A brand with this name already exists
brands.toastInUse: Brand is in use and cannot be deleted

warehouses.title: Warehouses
warehouses.description: Define storage locations. Stock is tracked per warehouse; purchase and sales orders target one warehouse each.
warehouses.codeAutoHint: Location is required. A display code (e.g. NASR-CITY-01) is assigned automatically from the location text.
warehouses.registerNotEmptyBody: Withdraw or zero out every tender before turning off the register for this warehouse.
warehouses.hasRegisterHint: POS and register payments can only use locations with a register.
warehouses.defaultMustHaveRegister: The default warehouse always has a register.
warehouses.primaryWarehouseMustHaveRegister: The primary warehouse (ID 1) always has a register.
warehouses.deleteWarehouseConfirm: This will permanently remove the warehouse. It must have no stock and no register payment history.
warehouses.deleteBlockedStock: This location still has stock. Transfer everything out, then try again.
warehouses.deleteBlockedRegister: Payments are still attributed to this register. It cannot be removed while ledger history references it.

stockMovements.title: Stock Movements
stockMovements.emptyMovementsFiltered: No stock movements match your filters.

orders.title: Orders
orders.subtitle: Manage your sales orders and create new ones
orders.allOrdersSubtitle: View, search and manage existing orders
orders.fillRowBeforeAdd: Choose a product on this row before adding another line.
orders.priceModifiedWarning: Unit price differs from the catalog (list) price for this order type.
orders.addToBalanceHint: Select a customer to carry the remainder on their account.
orders.pressF1Customer: Arrow keys and Enter to choose · Esc to close

orders.selectOrNew: Select an order from the list or start a new order.
orders.searchPlaceholder: Search by order number or customer name...
orders.validationPaymentTotal: Payment total must equal order total ({{total}})
orders.cancelConfirmMessage: Cancel order #{{number}}? Stock will be restored automatically for all items.
orders.cancelSettlementRetain: Keep total paid as customer wallet credit (one ledger line)

purchaseOrders.title: Purchase Orders
purchaseOrders.subtitle: Receive stock from suppliers and track payables.
purchaseOrders.allPurchaseOrdersSubtitle: Search, filter, and open any PO.
purchaseOrders.newPurchaseOrderSubtitle: Full-screen flow: supplier, products, costs, and payments.
purchaseOrders.searchSuppliers: Search suppliers by name or phone...
purchaseOrders.pressF1Supplier: Press F1 while the supplier field is focused to open this list. Arrow keys and Enter to select.
purchaseOrders.pressF1Products: Press F1 (or Add products) to browse catalog by category and brand. Shows cost price.
purchaseOrders.noLinkedSupplierHint: Enter a name manually below, or pick a supplier from your directory.
purchaseOrders.productAlreadyInPo: This product is already on the order.
purchaseOrders.addProductsHint: Use Add products or press F1 to pick items from the catalog.
purchaseOrders.toastDraftSaved: Draft saved. Confirm from the purchase order page when ready.
purchaseOrders.registerPaymentGateDescription: This receiving warehouse has no cash register. Choose which register should record supplier payments. The supplier’s balance and payables are still correct; only the cash register drawer is affected.
purchaseOrders.addToBalanceHint: Select a supplier to carry the remainder on their account (payables).
purchaseOrders.costPriceDiffWarning: Cost price differs from default (default: {{default}}). Update default price?
purchaseOrders.updateDefaultCostPrice: Yes, update default cost price for this product
purchaseOrders.costOverrideBody: Line "{{name}}" uses a unit cost that differs from the catalog default ({{listCost}}). Use this cost for this purchase order only, or update catalog prices (cost, customer, and business).
purchaseOrders.costOverrideBlurHint: Leave the cost field (blur) to choose how to handle the difference, or restore the catalog cost.
purchaseOrders.costOverrideUnsetError: For each line where cost differs from catalog, leave the cost field or choose “Allow once” or “Update catalog prices”.
purchaseOrders.catalogPricesHint: These values will be saved on the product when the purchase order is received.
purchaseOrders.originalPriceDisabledCatalog: Restore is disabled: you chose to update catalog prices when this purchase order is received.
purchaseOrders.validationSupplierRequired: Select a supplier from your directory before checkout.
purchaseOrders.validationCostPriceMin: Cost price must be 0 or greater
purchaseOrders.errorDraftStatusNotAllowed: Saving drafts requires a database update: apply migration 016 (purchase order draft status) to your Supabase project, then try again.
purchaseOrders.cancelConfirmMessage: Cancel purchase order #{{number}}? Stock will be deducted for all items.
purchaseOrders.cancelConfirmMessageDraft: Cancel draft purchase order #{{number}}? Nothing has been received into stock yet.
purchaseOrders.cancelSettlementRetain: Keep total paid as supplier wallet credit (one ledger line)
purchaseOrders.emptyOrders: No purchase orders match your filters.

inventoryTransfers.subtitle: Move products between warehouses. No prices—only quantities.
inventoryTransfers.newTransferSubtitle: Choose source and destination, add lines, confirm.
inventoryTransfers.promptDeleteWarehouseDescription: The source warehouse has no stock left. Remove it from your locations?

people.title: People
people.detailGrossProfitNeedsWac: Gross profit appears when every product on this customer's completed orders has an average unit cost (WAC).
people.detailNoPurchasesInRange: No received purchase lines in this date range.
people.detailMoneyOverTimeHelp: Sum of order totals (customer) and purchase order totals (supplier) per day. Two lines when this person is both customer and supplier.
people.detailMoneyChartEmpty: No orders or purchase orders in this date range.
people.name: Name
people.roleRemovalWarning: This person has {{count}} orders linked to their customer role. Remove the customer role only after reassigning orders.
people.roleRemovalWarningSupplier: This person has {{count}} purchase orders linked as supplier.
people.deleteBlocked: Cannot delete: person has linked records
people.validationNameMin: Name must be at least 2 characters
people.validationPhoneDuplicate: This phone number is already used by another person.
people.validationPhoneDuplicateNamed: This phone number is already used by {{name}}.

payments.hubIntro: Record balance payments or open the full transaction log (every ledger movement).
payments.hubDisabled: Payments hub shortcuts are turned off in Control settings.
payments.allPaymentsDesc: Full history of balance movements: sales orders, purchase orders, payments, wallet credits, and adjustments.
payments.newPaymentDesc: Choose a person and record received or made payment.
payments.newPaymentHint: Select who this payment applies to, then enter amount and type.
payments.searchPeople: Search by name, phone, or ID
payments.pressF1Person: Press F1 to open the person browser.
payments.listIntro: Complete ledger for the selected period—every operation that touched a person’s balance. Filter by type or person, or search.
payments.searchPlaceholder: Name, phone, walk-in, note, reference, type…
payments.expandNestedPaymentsAria: Show or hide checkout payment lines for this document
payments.listDocumentTotalHint: Sale total for an order, or purchase order liability total.
payments.listBalanceImpactHint: Default view: for sales orders, negative means the customer still owes (or net balance down), positive means credit or overpayment. Purchase orders keep signed payable remainder. Full ledger: raw signed ledger line. Green/red matches the sign of this column for linked people.
payments.listRegisterImpactHint: Net effect on the register (cash drawer and tender accounts): positive when money comes in, negative when paid out.
payments.noRegisterWarehouseForPayments: No warehouse with a register is configured. Add one under Inventory → Warehouses.
payments.splitHint: Enable each method you use and enter the amount (e.g. cash + card).
payments.overpaymentWarning: You are paying more than the total amount
payments.overpaymentWillBeAddedToWallet: will be added to wallet as credit
payments.selectPersonForOverpayment: Select a person to apply overpayment to their wallet
payments.showFullLedgerHelp: Include every balance line. When off, checkout payments that are already summarized on order and purchase order rows are hidden.
payments.paymentOperationNotFound: This payment could not be found.
payments.operationReversedBanner: This payment was reversed. Ledger rows are kept for audit with a reversal marker.
payments.reverseOperationConfirmDescription: This will undo the payment in the ledger, restore the person’s balance when applicable, and update the linked sales order or purchase order if this payment was tied to one. This cannot be undone from the app.
payments.operationNoteNoEditReversed: Notes cannot be edited after this payment was reversed.
payments.reversedBalanceImpactHint: This payment was reversed; net change to balance is zero.
payments.operationNoteReadOnly: Editing payment notes is turned off in Control settings.
payments.operationNoteLinkHint: Order and PO references like O-12 or PO-3 link when the note ends with a document marker from the system.

register.title: Register
register.subtitle: Running balance by tender (cash, card, cheque, InstaPay) from sales and purchases, plus manual movements.
register.disclaimer: Sales or purchase payments that were stored on the ledger without a payment method are counted toward Cash in the register. Split-tender orders use each method as recorded.
register.noRegisterWarehouse: No warehouse is set up with a cash register.
register.withdrawAllDisabled: Withdraw from register is turned off in Control settings.
register.withdrawAllConfirmDescription: One withdrawal will be recorded for each tender that has a balance. The register will read zero when finished.
register.disableRegisterPromptTitle: Turn off register for this warehouse?
register.disableRegisterPromptDescription: The register for “{{name}}” is empty. Do you want to disable the cash register for this location?
register.disableRegisterNotAllowed: The primary or default warehouse must keep a register.
